versions.changelog:
**Expanded Polymarket trading and automation with agent-based workflows.**

- Added support for browsing, trading, and automating strategies on Polymarket via natural language prompts.
- Search and filter prediction markets by keyword, category, date, or asset (crypto, stocks, sports, etc.).
- Place trades, manage orders, track positions and P&L, and redeem winnings directly from clients.
- Automate trading strategies, alerts, and market briefings through scheduled recipes.
- Improved onboarding and authentication using OAuth 2.1 and self-custodial wallets.
- Comprehensive documentation and usage examples included for easy setup.

- Bumped version to 0.1.2.
- Documentation updates only; SKILL.md and README.md revised.
- No functional or feature changes included in this release.

- Updated description to emphasize searching, trading, and automating strategies.
- Improved section formatting for better readability.
- No functionality changes; documentation and style enhancements only.

Initial release of Polymarket via Gina — automate, search, and trade prediction markets using natural language.

- Search and filter Polymarket markets by topic, volume, date, or status.
- Place market and limit orders, track positions and P&L, and manage open orders.
- Redeem winnings from resolved markets directly.
- Set up automated strategies and alerts via scheduled natural language prompts.
- Secure login via OAuth; self-custodial wallets with gas sponsorship included.
